dial.summary: BTC reclaims $80K support, rebounding to ~$82K despite back-to-back inflation shocks (CPI 3.7% YoY Oct 14, PPI 6.3% YoY Oct 15) — BTC.D rolled sharply from 59.3% to 57.5% in a single session (alts outperforming) while TOTAL holds at ~$2.86T; near-zero funding (0.003%) and expanding Global M2 ($103.7T) remain structural tailwinds; dial stays BTC Accumulation but BTC.D breach below 55% (sustained sub-50%) would confirm flip to Alt Rotation.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: MacroMicro G4 M2 aggregate (Fed/ECB/BOJ/PBOC) at ~$103.66T for August 2026 (latest month with all four economies reporting; 4-week trend UP: July $102.64T → August $103.66T, +$1.02T, +1.0% MoM); US M2 at $23.34T for August (FRED H.6); no September G4 aggregate yet (6–8 week reporting lag); status supportive (4-week trend is up); next full G4 update expected mid-November 2026.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: September 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 54.5% (released Oct 1, 2026; August 54.6%, 4-week change −0.1pp within flat threshold); ninth consecutive month above 50; New Orders 55.3, Production 56.7, Prices Paid 77.9% (multi-year high); status neutral (above 50 but not rising on 4-week basis); October PMI not yet available; next release November 2, 2026.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY spot at ~102.04 (Oct 15, 2026 close per Trading Economics) — retreated 0.45–0.50% from 18-month intraday high of 102.94 on Oct 14 (post-CPI surge); DXY fell despite hot September PPI (6.3% YoY released Oct 15), suggesting some near-term exhaustion; 4-week trend UP from ~99.90 on Sep 15 to 102.04 (+2.1%); status headwind (above 100 threshold); FOMC Oct 28 decision is next major catalyst.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield (DFII10) at 2.84% as of October 14, 2026 (eased from cycle high of 2.95% on Oct 5 and 2.88% on Oct 13); 4-week trend UP from ~2.52% on Sep 9 to 2.84% (+32bps); 52-week range 1.68%–2.95%; status headwind (rising on 4-week basis and well above 2% threshold); hot September PPI (6.3% YoY) adds further upside pressure into Oct 28 FOMC.

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: October 15, 2026: 2s10s spread narrowed to +33bps (from +37bps on Oct 14 and ~+42bps on Sep 15); 4-week trend DOWN (Sep 15 ~+42bps → Oct 15 +33bps = −9bps, meaningful flattening); status neutral — curve remains positively sloped (not a headwind) but is flattening (not supportive); hot CPI/PPI and rising front-end hike expectations are compressing the short end; FOMC Oct 28 decision is the next major curve catalyst.

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,755,639M ($6.756T) for week ending October 14, 2026 (new H.4.1 data released Oct 15, 2026; prior week Oct 7 = $6,747,560M, +$8,079M WoW); 4-week trend flat: Sep 16 $6,746,548M → Oct 14 $6,755,639M = +$9,091M (+0.13%); status supportive (flat near post-QT-pause stabilization plateau — Reserve Management Purchases offsetting MBS runoff); next H.4.1 release covers week ending Oct 21, due Oct 22.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: BTC weighted 8h perp funding rate at ~0.0029% as of October 14, 2026 (Au79 Macro Research citing CoinGlass); 30-day trend DOWN from ~0.0067% on Sep 30 to ~0.003% on Oct 14; BTC rebounded to ~$82K on Oct 16 despite hot September PPI (6.3% YoY); open interest near $67.7B with perps-to-spot ratio 19.2x (elevated OI but no overheated funding); status supportive (well below 0.04% overheating threshold — spot-driven, not speculative).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$299.2B on October 16, 2026 (CoinGecko via CoinGabbar, 4:00 AM UTC) vs total crypto ~$2.86T → dominance ~10.46% (~10.5%); down from 10.75% peak on Oct 14 as BTC/alts recovered; 30-day trend flat (Sep 16 est. ~10.5% → Oct 16 ~10.46%, negligible net change); status neutral (not clearly falling — not supportive; not rising alongside total market on 30-day basis — not headwind); BTC.D dropped sharply to 57.5% from 59.3%, early alt rotation signal — watch for sustained BTC.D sub-55%.

upcoming.title: Housing Starts & Building Permits (September 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases September 2026 Housing Starts and Building Permits at 8:30 AM ET; with real yields at 2.84% and mortgage rates elevated, continued monthly declines would underscore the drag from high financing costs on residential investment; provides incremental Q3 data ahead of the October 29 GDP advance estimate.

upcoming.title: Initial Jobless Claims (week ended October 18, 2026)
upcoming.note: DOL weekly initial jobless claims at 8:30 AM ET for the week ended October 18, 2026 — last major labor data point before the October 28 FOMC decision; a sustained trend above 220K would raise recession risk; carries outsized weight given the September NFP of +29K, hot CPI (3.7% YoY), and hot PPI (6.3% YoY) backdrop heading into the meeting.

upcoming.title: S&P Global US Flash PMI (October 2026)
upcoming.note: S&P Global releases preliminary October 2026 Manufacturing and Services PMI at 9:45 AM ET — first Q4 activity data point, released four days before the FOMC meeting begins; September ISM Manufacturing at 54.5% sets a high bar; a flash manufacturing print below 52 would suggest deceleration and reinforce Fed hold expectations despite hot inflation.
